filmhouse.title: La La Land (10th Anniversary)
filmhouse.description: Mia, an aspiring actress, serves lattes to movie stars in between auditions and Sebastian, a jazz musician, scrapes by playing cocktail party gigs in dingy bars, but as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart. In English with Mandarin Subtitles Rated PG13 for Some Coarse Language

filmhouse.title: The Invite
filmhouse.description: You’re cordially invited to the most chaotic dinner of the year. Fresh from its buzz heavy Sundance debut, Olivia Wilde’s razor sharp relationship comedy hits right where it hurts. Joe (Seth Rogen) and Angela (Wilde) are stuck in a domestic rut, made worse by the aggressively loud, boundary pushing love life of their upstairs neighbors, Hawk (Edward Norton) and Pina (Penélope Cruz). Hoping to smooth things over, Angela invites them down for a casual dinner party. But as the wine flows, polite small talk is instantly traded for a chaotic, hilariously uncomfortable truth game where social etiquette completely crumbles. In English Rated M18 for Mature Content and Coarse Language.

filmhouse.title: Girls Like Girls
filmhouse.description: The film title rings a bell? You're probably thinking of that 2015 anthem with the iconic music video that became a touchstone for a generation of queer women. Ten years on, Hayley Kiyoko, affectionately dubbed the "Lesbian Jesus" by fans, brings her beloved song to the big screen in her feature directorial debut! Set over one unforgettable, sun-soaked summer, Girls Like Girls follows Coley, the new girl in town, as she experiences the exhilaration, uncertainty, and vulnerability of first love while learning to embrace who she truly is. Starring Maya da Costa, Myra Molloy, and Zach Braff, the film is a heartfelt coming-of-age story about self-discovery, friendship, and the courage to choose yourself. To celebrate the film's Singapore exclusive release at Filmhouse, we're so excited to present a virtual Q&A with Hayley Kiyoko herself after the Fri 7 Aug, 8.30pm premiere , moderated by local artist and beloved queer icon Jean Seizure. Join us for an intimate conversation about bringing an internet-era cultural phenomenon to the screen, queer storytelling, and Kiyoko's journey from musician to filmmaker. In English Rated R21 for Homosexual Content.

filmhouse.title: WATCH IT WET: NDP 2026 Watch Party
filmhouse.description: One people, one nation, one drink-apore! This is the National Day Parade watch party of your dreams! A room full of friends and strangers united by a general…ambivalence to the project of patriotism, an in-theatre bar, sing-along, yell-along viewing and of course DRINKING GAMES! The nation’s booziest National Day Parade watch party is back with a new venue partner (we know!). Come stand up, get drunk and stumble home for Singapore while the nation’s finest emcees (in our price range) say all the things in your head that you want to say aloud! And who are these fine emcees providing live commentary? Qilah Rose Her buttock damn big sia. Wow! Lychee Bye Juicy, fleshy, luscious and quite rude! Kishan Kumar Singh Pink Dot's emcee and half of the T42 podcast. Becca D’Bus The foul mouthed host of RIOT!, Singapore’s only regular drag revue. ALSO! Prize for the best dressed person! Come as your Singaporean thing ! Get Ticket Here! Please note: The event is 18+ Ticket sales are final and are not refundable Support our venue partners, no outside food and drink

filmhouse.title: I Want Your Sex
filmhouse.description: Cult legend Gregg Araki returns in full frontal, uninhibited style with a razor sharp erotic comedy that pushes all the right buttons! When wide eyed Elliot (Cooper Hoffman) lands a dream job assisting boundary pushing artist Erika Tracy (Olivia Wilde), he is plunged headfirst into a raunchy, neon-drenched playground of art, obsession, and dangerously messy workplace dynamics in this glossy and campy sex comedy. Sundance critics and audiences hailed "I Want Your Sex" as a "hilarious, horny, and unapologetic cure for a sexless generation" In English Rated R21 for Mature Theme and Sexual Scenes

filmhouse.title: Oldboy - 4K Restoration
filmhouse.description: Long before Parasite and Squid Game hijacked global pop culture, Park Chan-wook’s operatic, Cannes-winning masterpiece completely redefined what a thriller could be. Don't miss out this re-release of the 4k restoration, for a limited time only! Oh Dae-su is abruptly kidnapped off the street and locked in a windowless hotel room for 15 years with no explanation. Just as suddenly, he is released, given a suit, a cell phone, and exactly five days to figure out who ruined his life and why. What follows is a pitch-black, hyper violent journey to the absolute brink of psychological vengeance. In Korean with English subtitles. Rated R21 for Mature Themes. TW: Contains themes of Sexual Violence.

filmhouse.title: Silent Friend
filmhouse.description: On the grounds of a medieval German university town looms an imposing Ginkgo biloba, a tree whose longevity stands in marked contrast to three intimate, human-scaled stories. In 1908, the university’s first female student gains admission into the prestigious botany department, confronting the sexism of both professors and peers. In 1972, amidst counterculture movements, a reserved student finds his attention captured by a fellow housemate and the geranium plant she studies. In 2020, during the COVID-19 pandemic, a neuroscientist from Hong Kong secures the help of a renowned botanist for an experiment on the old ginkgo tree. In German, Cantonese and English with English subitles. Rated M18 for Some Nudity and Drug Use.

filmhouse.title: Obsession
filmhouse.description: Every now and then, a genre film arrives out of nowhere to completely rewrite the theatrical rulebook, and this year, that lightning strike is Curry Barker’s Obsession. The story kicks off when hopeless romantic Bear uses a eerie "One Wish Willow" to make his long time crush, Nikki, fall for him. It works, but with a massive catch: her newfound "love" instantly mutates into a blood soaked, obsessive situationship. Produced on a shoestring budget of under a million dollars, this relentless piece of supernatural terror has exploded into an absolute box office success in the US. At the center of the madness is breakout star Inde Navarrette, delivering an incredibly unhinged and nuanced performance, cleverly using the horror framework to look at deeper anxieties surrounding control, consent, and women's bodily autonomy. Judging by the squirming and collective nervous laughter from our team during our preview screening, you are going to want to witness this instant cult classic in a packed theater full of gasping, screaming filmhomies. In English. Rated M18 for Violence and Sexual Scene.

filmhouse.title: The Odyssey
filmhouse.description: Leave it to Christopher Nolan to take a 3,000-year-old high school reading assignment and turn it into an epic popcorn blockbuster that doubles as a sharp critique of hubris, greed, and the human cost of imperialism. Following the fall of Troy, King Odysseus embarks on a treacherous ten-year journey across the Mediterranean to return to his kingdom of Ithaca. While he navigates terrifying monsters and the wrath of sea gods, his wife Penelope must hold their home together against a ruthless horde of suitors claiming his throne and his family. In English with English and Mandarin subtitles. Rated NC16 for Violence. TW: Contains scenes with flashing lights, photosensitive audience members are advised.

filmhouse.title: The World of Love
filmhouse.description: This touching drama tells the story of Jooin, an enigmatic 17-year-old high school student. She is a cheerful friend, a shameless daughter, a mischievous girlfriend, and a person who is always hard to predict. One day, after a fellow classmate asks Jooin to sign a petition to prevent a newly released sex offender from moving into their neighbourhood, Jooin refuses, causing a major scene. She starts to receive anonymous notes questioning her behavior, and cracks begin to appear in her formerly peaceful world. Join us on 2 and 3 July for an in-person Q&A with Director Yoon Ga-Eun. "I even felt professional jealousy." — Bong Joon-ho on THE WORLD OF LOVE In Korean with English subtitles. Rated PG13 for Some Sexual References. TW: Themes of Sexual Assault Toronto International Film Festival 2025 - World Premiere 9th Pingyao International Film Festival 2025 - Jury Award & People's Choice Award for Best Film BFI London Film Festival 2025 - Competition

upcoming.description: Academy Award® nominee Monica Barbaro (A Complete Unknown, Top Gun: Maverick) and BAFTA nominee Callum Turner (Masters of the Air, Fantastic Beasts franchise) star as Allie and Owen, two love-starved strangers who crash into each other in an ever-so-slightly fictionalized New York City on the one night of the year when single people are allowed to have sex. Recently dumped Owen and hopeful romantic Allie might be the only two singles in the city looking for more than just a quick encounter. As they each race toward and away from each other across the city, they just might discover that the one thing they want most is closer than they think.

upcoming.title: Insidious: Out Of The Further
upcoming.description:
Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the
Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what
The Further is capable of. In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as
Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in
who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost
souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after
her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just
enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world.
Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.

upcoming.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage (KOR)
upcoming.description: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong (UHM Jung-hwa) finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan (PARK Sung-woong). When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min’s family and Ji-hoon (RYEO-UN), a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot…

upcoming.title: Sunny Dancer
upcoming.description: As if conquering cancer wasn't hard enough, 17-year-old Ivy's parents sign her up to spend her summer at what she calls "chemo camp", where she manages to find unexpected friends in a group of misfits and has a summer she'll never forget.

upcoming.title: All Wishes Come True! (M)
upcoming.description: On a wondrous island where mortals and Immortals dwell as one, a legendary vault holds a fortune beyond dreaming. Lü Dongbin and Zhongli Quan have a plan. To crack that vault, these two mortals will pull off the impossible: pose as Immortals themselves. They gather six more misfits along the way: He Xiangu, Tieguai Li, Han Xiangzi, Cao Guojiu, Lan Caihe, and Zhang Guolao. Eight ordinary souls, one extraordinary heist, and death waiting for anyone caught trying to outsmart the heavens.

upcoming.title: The Dog Stars
upcoming.description: The film tells the story of Hig (Jacob Elordi), a young pilot who, together with a military survivalist, Bangley (Josh Brolin), has carved out an efficient but isolated homestead in a brutal post-apocalyptic world. But when Hig receives a mysterious radio transmission, he ventures into the unknown in search of the hope and humanity he still believes exist.

upcoming.title: Tony
upcoming.description: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

upcoming.title: IDIOTS
upcoming.description: Two rock-bottom drivers transport a wealthy teen to rehab, but their simple job spirals into a chaotic journey of drugs, danger, and crime as their passenger derails their plans.

Hope’s police outpost chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae struggle to defend a village of the elderly, while in the mountains, Sung-ki and the locals who set out to track the beast find themselves hunted instead. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

unwittingly finds himself in an action-packed, non-stop race for
survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in
chaos.

Adapted from Colleen Hoover's best-selling novel, this seductive,

Hathaway) and Lowen Ashleigh (Dakota Johnson), a struggling writer who
relocates to the remote Crawford estate to ghostwrite for Verity. After Lowen
uncovers what appears to be Verity's chilling autobiographical notes, she
wrestles with the disturbing and twisted confessions about Verity’s husband
Jeremy (Josh Hartnett), and finds it hard to separate fiction from reality,
manipulation from attraction, and opportunity from obsession.

With only a week to make them look good, can the Sandbox team turn these zeroes into heroes… and maybe save themselves in the process?
